# cpanel_redirect (Resource)

Manages one cPanel HTTP redirect rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_redirect" "legacy" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  source      = "/old"
  destination = "https://example.com/new"
  type        = "permanent"
  www_mode    = "both"
  wildcard    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) The absolute HTTP or HTTPS destination URL.
- `domain` (String) The cPanel account domain that owns the redirect.

### Optional

- `source` (String) The absolute URL path to redirect. Defaults to `/`.
- `type` (String) Whether the redirect is `permanent` (`301`) or `temporary` (`302`).
- `wildcard` (Boolean) Whether matching files below the source path keep their relative path below the destination.
- `www_mode` (String) Whether the redirect matches `both` www and non-www requests, or only requests `without` www. cPanel does not expose enough read metadata to manage its separate www-only mode safely.

### Read-Only

- `document_root` (String) The absolute document root whose `.htaccess` file contains the redirect.
- `kind` (String) The redirect directive kind reported by cPanel.
- `status_code` (Number) The HTTP status code reported by cPanel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_redirect.legacy 'example.com|/old'
```
